in_hebrew.name: ארפד
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם ארפד מקורו בשפה ההונגרית ומשמעותו עזרה או תמיכה מאלוהים. הוא קשור לשם העברי ארפד, שפירושו 'אדם שנחלץ לעזרתו של אלוהים'. השם מופיע בתנ"ך כבן של סנחריב, מלך אשור.

in_greek.name: Άρπαδ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Άρπαδ προέρχεται από την Ουγγρική γλώσσα και σημαίνει βοήθεια από τον Θεό. Είναι συνδεδεμένο με την Εβραϊκή ονομασία ארפד, που σημαίνει 'άνθρωπος που τρέχει για να βοηθήσει τον Θεό'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη δεν υπάρχει συγκεκριμένη αναφορά, αλλά το όνομα σχετίζεται με την πνευματική βοήθεια και προστασία.

in_latin.name: Arpad
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Arpad originem habet in lingua Hungarica et significat auxilium a Deo. Connectitur cum nomine hebraico ארפד, quod interpretatur 'homo qui accurrit ad auxilium Dei'. In ecclesia primitiva christiana, nomen hoc habebat significationem spiritualem et protectionem divinam.

in_english.name: Arpad
in_english.meaning: Divine help or support from God
in_english.long_meaning: The name Arpad originates from Hungarian and means 'divine help' or 'support from God'. It is linked to the Hebrew name ארפד (Arpad), meaning 'man who rushes to God's help'. Although not directly mentioned in the Bible, the name carries significant spiritual meaning related to divine assistance and protection. Historically, it has been used in Christian traditions to signify faith and reliance on God.

data.cultural_impact: The name Arpad holds a significant cultural impact in Hungarian history, as it is the name of the founder of the Hungary as a state, Arpad Hungary. Arpad is remembered as a legendary hero, a brave leader who led his people from their homeland in the eastern steppes to the Carpathian basin in 896 AD Arpad is considered the ancestor of all Hungarian kings and used to be mentioned in the Hungarian pledge of allegiance. The name Arpad is not only a personal name but also a family name and is found in the Hungarian nobility even today.
